import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';

part 'prepared_capability_contract.g.dart';

@AdeleValue('test.capability.value')
final class ProbeValue {
  const ProbeValue({
    required this.provider,
    required this.configuration,
    required this.sequence,
    required this.text,
  });

  final String provider;
  final String configuration;
  final int sequence;
  final String text;
}

@AdeleService('test.capability.probe')
abstract interface class CapabilityProbeService {
  @AdeleMethod('read')
  Future<ProbeValue> read(String scope);

  @AdeleMethod('watch')
  Stream<ProbeValue> watch(String scope);
}
